description: This file contains LESS mixins and functions for generating grid classes for Bootstrap, including methods for creating grid columns, float grids, and advanced grid calculations such as widths, pushes, pulls, and offsets. It is used specifically to generate responsive grid CSS based on parameters like column count and gutter width.

methods.name: .make-grid
methods.description: Creates a grid for a specified class by generating columns, pushes, pulls, and offsets based on the grid columns variable.

methods.name: .make-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates CSS classes for grid columns across all sizes (xs, sm, md, lg) for a given number of grid columns.

methods.name: .float-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates float-based grid classes for a specific class across all column sizes.

methods.name: .calc-grid-column
methods.description: Calculates specific CSS properties (width, left, right, margin) for grid columns, push, pull, and offset based on index and class.

methods.name: .loop-grid-columns
methods.description: Iterates from the given index down to zero, applying grid calculations for each step.
